correctness.rationale: Every trace class is proved by a complete split into incident and disjoint pairs and common-center triples, with explicit witness conditions. Every four-support is excluded by a mixed-trace obstruction. Nine vertices are necessary from eight distinct witnesses and sufficient by the four-arm construction. An independent stdlib verifier checks 18,948 trees plus an unlabeled-tree enumeration on 2,287 types; these tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: A natural definable one-point-type/shattering invariant now has exact degree coefficients for every member of the nontrivial family of line graphs of trees. The sharp VC threshold and nine-vertex extremizer refine a general Johnson bound and distinguish local depth-2 and depth-3 branching behavior, offering explicit structural rather than ad hoc finite data.
